column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rule configuration — ArtisanMarket client (Staging stage, 4.3.7)
# Scope note: the DAST target in CI is `vite preview`, a static file server for
# the built SPA. Response-header policy (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, Permissions
# Policy, COEP) is applied at the CDN / static host in front of the bundle, not
# by the bundle itself — see threat T5 in docs/threat-model.md. Those rules are
# therefore scoped out of this scan rather than silently passed: T5 records that
# they must be verified against the deployed host, which this job does not cover.
# Everything not listed here stays at its default severity, so any genuine
# application-layer finding (XSS, injection, disclosure) still fails the gate.

column3: Anti-clickjacking header — set by the static host, not the bundle (T5)
X-Content-Type-Options — set by the static host, not the bundle (T5)
Content Security Policy — set by the static host, not the bundle (T5)
CSP directive fallback — follows from 10038; host-layer policy (T5)
Permissions Policy — set by the static host, not the bundle (T5)
Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy — set by the static host, not the bundle (T5)
Storable/cacheable content — expected for immutable hashed static assets
Timestamp disclosure — matches build hashes and numeric literals in the bundle
Modern Web Application — informational; the target is a React SPA by design
Sub Resource Integrity — assets are same-origin and content-hashed by Vite
